|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “'''Local Uprising (V)'''<br />''Deploy Hoth, Echo Command Center, and Main Power Gen-erators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps. While this side up, once per turn, you may ▼one exterior Hoth site or non-unique Rebel to Hoth. Flip this card during your move phase if your T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels control 3 exterior Hoth sites. Place out of play if 1st Marker "blown away."<br /><br />'''Liberation (V)'''<br />While this side up, each time you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground) it is limited to 1. Once during each of your control phases, may use 2 Force to ▲ any card. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with a speeder. Flip this card if you do not control 2 exterior Hoth sites. Place out of play if 1st Marker "blown away."”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “'''0 side – Local Uprising (V)'''<br />''Deploy Hoth system and Main Power Generators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps.'' '''For''' remainder of game, you may not deploy Hoth Sentry or non-Hoth locations (except Rendezvous Point). T-47 Battle Formation is an Out Of Play Interrupt and (Immune to Sense.). '''While''' this side up, during your deploy phase, may deploy an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip''' this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators ‘blown away.’<br /><br />'''7 side – Liberation (V)'''<br />'''While''' this side up, whenever you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage, or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of Hoth locations you occupy. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site (except 1st Marker) you control with both a T-47 and a Rebel. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip''' this card if you do not control two exterior Hoth sites. '''Place''' out of play if Main Power Generators ‘blown away.’” '''What changed:''' “'''Local” → “'''0 side – Local”; “Hoth, Echo Command Center,” → “Hoth system”; “Gen-erators.” → “Generators.”; “Flaps. ''For” → “Flaps.'' '''For'''”; “play” → “deploy”; “Point), and you may only play” → “Point).”; “twice. While” → “is an Out Of Play Interrupt and (Immune to Sense.). '''While'''”; “once per turn, you” → “during your deploy phase,”; “▼one” → “deploy an”; added “a”; “Hoth. Flip” → “Hoth from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip'''”; “your” → “you control three exterior Hoth sites with”; and further rewording (compare the full texts).
